items.title: LILYGO T-Dongle-C5 – An ESP32-C5 USB dongle with microSD card slot, optional 0.96-inch OLED
items.summary: LILYGO T-Dongle-C5 is an ESP32-C5 dual-band WiFi 6, BLE, and 802.15.4 USB dongle that builds upon the earlier ESP32-S3-based T-Dongle-S3 board. items.title: Nordic nRF54LC10A – A tiny Bluetooth LE and 802.15.4 SoC with sub-50 nA hibernation mode
items.summary: Nordic Semiconductor recently expanded its nRF54L Series with the nRF54LC10A, a new SoC with less memory and a smaller peripheral set compared to the higher-end nRF54L15, while supporting Bluetooth LE with Channel Sounding and IEEE 802.15.4 for Thread, Zigbee, and Matter. Built on a 22nm process, the SoC combines a 128 MHz Arm Cortex-M33 processor with a multiprotocol 2.4 GHz radio. It also features a sub-50 nA hibernation mode for devices shipped with (3V) batteries installed, reducing battery drain during storage and transportation. items.title: CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: The AIMORELOGY Ovis is an open-source AI vision camera module built around the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, with full-color 1080p night vision and 1.5 TOPS edge AI inference in a compact modular design. It is designed for drones, robotics, security systems, smart cameras, and custom embedded vision products. The camera features a compact stacked design, with a 20 × 20 mm Core board that includes the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, 2 Gbit NAND flash, USB, and UART debug pads. A Sensor board with the SC235HAI image sensor connects on top and also adds Ethernet and UART interfaces. An optional CVBS board goes between the Sensor board and the Ovis Core board. AIMORELOGY Ovis specifications: Ovis Core Board SoC – CVITEK CV1842H-P CPU – 1x Arm Cortex-A53 core @ 1.1 GHz, 1x RISC-V C906 core @ 800 MHz NPU – 1.5 TOPS @ INT8 with BF16 support ISP – AI-ISP with real-time 1080p [...] The post CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding) appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers
items.summary: Last year, we saw Morse Micro introduce the MM8108 Wi-Fi HaLow (802.11ah) SoC with up to 43.33 Mbps throughput, along with an MM8108-RD09 USB dongle reference design, for which we had virtually no details at the time. Morse Micro has now released USB-A and USB-C Wi-Fi HaLow adapters based on that reference design. The adapters let PCs and routers connect to 802.11ah networks through USB without a dedicated expansion card and feature an external SMA antenna delivering up to 26 dBm transmit power. Wi-Fi HaLow USB network adapter specifications: SoC – Morse Micro MM8108 32-bit RISC-V Host Applications Processor (HAP) Standard – IEEE802.11ah Wi-Fi HaLow Frequency band – 850-950 MHz (Worldwide sub-1 GHz license-exempt range) Operating Modes – Access Point (AP) and Station (STA). Channel Width – 1/2/4/8 MHz Modulation – BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, 256QAM. Data rate – Up to 43.3 Mbps using 256-QAM modulation at an 8 MHz bandwidth [...] The post Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity
items.summary: JetKVM Mini is a smaller, lower-cost version of the popular JetKVM KVM over IP solution. The new model features a small information display, offers Ethernet or WiFi connectivity, and supports 1080p video capture. The main under-the-hood change is that they ditched Linux on a Rockchip RV1106G3 SoC and now rely on an ESP32-P4X (ESP32-P4 version 3.x and greater) to handle video capture, H.264 encoding, USB, and other features. The largest cost saving is removing the RAM and eMMC flash required by Linux. JetKVM Mini specifications: SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-P4X CPU Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V HP (High-performance) CPU @ up to 400 MHz with AI instruction extension and single-precision FPU Single-RISC-V LP (Low-power) MCU core @ up to 40 MHz Memory 768 KB HP L2MEM (for dual-core CPU), 32 KB LP SRAM, 8 KB TCM (for LP MCU core) 32 MB PSRAM Storage – 128 KB HP ROM, 16 KB LP ROM [...] The post JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: New Patch Series Working Toward DRBD 9 Support In The Linux Kernel
items.summary: Earlier this year developers at LINBIT began working toward a goal of upstreaming ~15 years worth of their Distributed Replicated Block Device changes into the mainline Linux kernel. That major update has yet to land but sent out this week was a new patch series in preparing the trek toward introducing DRBD 9 support in the mainline kernel...

items.title: AMDXDNA Linux Driver Being Enhanced For Current NPU3 Hardware
items.summary: The AMDXDNA open-source Linux kernel accelerator driver is seeing a fair amount of work for better supporting current-generation NPU3 neural processing units. The AMD NPU3 is what's found in current AMD Ryzen AI 300 / Ryzen AI 300 PRO series SoCs...
items.title_zh: AMDXDNA Linux 驱动增强以更好支持 NPU3 硬件
items.summary_zh: AMD 开源 Linux 内核加速器驱动 AMDXDNA 正在获得大量改进，以更好支持现一代 NPU3 神经网络处理单元。NPU3 用于当前 AMD Ryzen AI 300 与 Ryzen AI 300 PRO 系列 SoC，相关补丁涵盖电源管理、用户态接口及上下文恢复等方面。
items.why_it_matters_zh: NPU3 驱动完善有助于释放 Ryzen AI 300 平台本地 AI 推理性能，推动 Linux 端 AI PC 生态发展。

items.title: New FUTEX Syscalls Back To Being Worked On For Helping Valve's ARM64 Gaming Ambitions
items.summary: Going back to last year the Igalia open-source consulting firm has been working on enhancing the Linux kernel to help Steam Play gaming on ARM64 and ensuring the FEX emulator is operating efficiently for x86/x86_64 games running on the likes of the Steam Frame. After other kernel work in recent months, there's finally an updated round of the FUTEX get_robust_list2 and set_robust_list2 system call patches...
items.title_zh: 新 FUTEX 系统调用补丁助力 Valve ARM64 游戏计划
items.summary_zh: Igalia 正在为 Linux 内核开发新的 FUTEX get_robust_list2 与 set_robust_list2 系统调用补丁，旨在提升 ARM64 平台上的 Steam Play 游戏体验，让 FEX 模拟器更高效地运行 x86 与 x86_64 游戏。
items.why_it_matters_zh: FUTEX 改进可提升 ARM64 Linux 设备如 Steam Frame 的 x86 游戏兼容性与运行效率。

items.title: Redox OS Adds IO_uring-Like API, NUMA & Gets QEMU Working
items.summary: The Redox OS open-source, Rust-based operating system has seen a lot of activity in recent weeks with many notable improvements landing...
items.title_zh: Redox OS新增类IO_uring API与NUMA支持并修复QEMU运行
items.summary_zh: 基于Rust语言的开源操作系统Redox OS近期迎来多项重要更新，包括引入类IO_uring的异步I/O接口、NUMA支持以及修复QEMU运行问题等，功能逐步完善。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Rust生态操作系统Redox OS在异步I/O和多核架构方面持续完善，逐步缩小与主流系统的差距。

items.title: Approaching A 10 Second Linux Kernel Build
items.summary: The coffee window is closing. Going back many years with the time it's taken to compile the Linux kernel has been a well known opportunity for a coffee break or even eating a meal during the lengthy Linux kernel build process. Even when the Linux kernel was much smaller than it is today, with the hardware at the time it would often be a very time consuming process... Thus incredible to think that we are now on the horizon of a ten second clean, default kernel build on Linux x86_64.
items.title_zh: Linux内核构建时间逼近10秒大关
items.summary_zh: 长期以来Linux内核编译一直是开发者喝咖啡的理由，但随着构建工具优化和硬件进步，x86_64平台默认配置的全量编译已接近10秒内完成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 内核编译速度大幅提升将显著改善开发效率，加快Linux内核迭代与测试周期。

items.title: Patches Posted For Enabling NVMe On All Apple M3 Based SoCs With Linux
items.summary: While Linux 7.2 brought initial Apple M3 support and Linux 7.3 brought M3 Pro / Max / Ultra support, the mainline Linux kernel support for the M3 series hardware remains very basic and not yet ready for daily driving. But more work continues to be upstreamed and today the patches were posted for getting NVMe storage up and running across all Apple M3 hardware...
items.title_zh: 补丁发布：为Linux在Apple M3全系SoC上启用NVMe支持
items.summary_zh: Linux 7.2初步支持Apple M3，7.3加入M3 Pro/Max/Ultra，但M3系列硬件在主线Linux内核中仍处于非常基础的阶段。最新发布的补丁旨在让所有M3硬件支持NVMe存储，进一步完善上游支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: NVMe是基本存储能力，该补丁意味着Apple Silicon在Linux上的可用性又向前迈进一步。

items.title: Linux Kernel Developers Consider Adding AGENTS.md To Help Guide AI/LLM Agents
items.summary: While the Linux kernel continues to be bombarded with patches from AI/LLM agents, to date the kernel hasn't carried an AGENTS.md Markdown file with instructions catering to AI/LLM agents. But a patch set out today would finally introduce one...
items.title_zh: Linux内核开发者考虑引入AGENTS.md以引导AI/LLM代理
items.summary_zh: 面对大量AI/LLM代理提交的补丁，Linux内核此前一直缺少专门的AGENTS.md说明文件。最新补丁集提议正式引入该文件，为AI代理提供明确的代码贡献指引和规范。
items.why_it_matters_zh: AGENTS.md有望减少低质量AI生成补丁，提升内核代码审核与社区协作效率。

items.title: AMD Posts GCC Compiler Patches For AVX10V1AUX ISA Support
items.summary: Following their recent AVX10_V2_AUX support for GCC as part of the bring-up for the AI Compute Extensions "ACE" in GCC 17, AMD compiler engineers this week posted the initial patches for enabling the AVX10V1AUX ISA support...
items.title_zh: AMD 发布 GCC 编译器补丁以支持 AVX10V1AUX ISA
items.summary_zh: 在为 GCC 17 添加 AVX10_V2_AUX 支持以配合 AI 计算扩展（ACE）之后，AMD 编译器工程师本周提交了启用 AVX10V1AUX ISA 支持的初始补丁。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 新补丁将在开源编译器中启用 AVX10 向量指令集，有助于推动 AMD 下一代处理器的软件生态发展。

items.title: Linux Kernel Introducing New Taint Due To Fuzzing Bots Yielding Impractical Bug Reports
items.summary: The Linux kernel is having to introduce a new taint flag "TAINT_FORCED_BIND" to deal with fuzzing bots like Syzbot abusing Linux's bind/unbind sysfs functionality and generating bug reports for impractical and not at all relevant hardware/driver combinations...
items.title_zh: Linux 内核新增污点标志以应对模糊测试机器人产生的无效报告
items.summary_zh: Linux 内核将引入名为 "TAINT_FORCED_BIND" 的新污点标志，专门应对 Syzbot 等模糊测试机器人滥用 bind/unbind sysfs 功能、生成大量不切实际且与硬件/驱动组合无关的 Bug 报告的问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该机制可有效过滤无效缺陷报告，减轻内核维护者负担并提升问题跟踪效率。

items.title: CyboPal ONE – An AI-powered, 6-DOF robotic terminal with 27-inch 4K display that adjusts to your posture (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: CyboPal ONE is a 6-axis desktop robotic terminal designed to move a 27-inch 4K display using voice and gesture control, spatial sensing, and automatic display positioning based on the user’s position. It includes a camera, a binocular 3D sensor, and a motion sensor (IMU), and supports joint force sensing, obstacle avoidance, collision detection, and power-loss soft landing. The 6-DOF arm has a 747 mm reach and supports face tracking, manual adjustment, and saved positions. A built-in Pauli agent also provides voice control for screen positioning, application control, text input, and workflow tasks across Windows, macOS, and Linux. items.title: Brainchip AKD1500 M.2 and PCIe Edge AI cards, BrainBoard 1500 SPI module now available for $99 and up
items.summary: Back in November 2025, we wrote about the Brainchip AKD1500 PCIe/SPI Edge AI co-processor designed for low-power systems and delivering up to 800 GOPS at just 300 mW. In recent months, the company has launched several hardware platforms based on the ADK1500. At the end of July, Brainchip introduced the AKD1500 M.2 B+M Key development card for $129, shortly followed by the $99 BrainBoard 1500 module in August, and a few days ago, the company started selling the AKD1500 PCIe development card for $149. items.title: tamnd/rucc updated on GitHub
items.summary: An optimizing C compiler written in Rust. Verified rewrite rules, acyclic e-graphs, no external assembler. The target ladder is SQLite, then PostgreSQL, then the Linux kernel. Stars: 4.
items.title_zh: rucc：用Rust编写的优化型C编译器
items.summary_zh: rucc是一款基于Rust开发的优化型C编译器，采用经验证的rewrite规则和acyclic e-graphs，无需外部汇编器。项目目标阶梯依次为SQLite、PostgreSQL，最终瞄准Linux内核。GitHub Star数：4。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以Rust实现C编译器并瞄准Linux内核，若成熟有望为RISC-V及通用平台提供新的编译器选择。
